public.title: {workspace} waitlist
public.intro: Leave your contact and we'll let you know as soon as a slot opens.
public.crisis: If you are in crisis or thinking about hurting yourself, don't wait: call your local emergency number (in Brazil, 188 CVV or 192 SAMU) or go to an emergency room.

public.reasonHint: One sentence is enough. If you are at risk right now, don't write it here: call your local emergency number.
public.urgent: I'm going through a hard time and would like to be contacted first. I understand this list is not monitored in real time.

public.noGuarantee: Signing up does not guarantee care or a date.
